issues.explanation: Chapter 76 says Guan Yu learns that his family has been captured, but Source Chapter 75 explicitly says Wu houses Guan Yu's family separately and forbids interference; Source Chapter 76 later confirms the families are safe and well supplied. The adaptation also later says the soldiers flee because their families are safe, creating an internal contradiction.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “家眷被俘” with “家眷被吴军控制” or “荆州失守，家眷下落不明,” and preserve that Wu treats the families well.
